body.statement: The frozen panel is complete at the observed grain: each of the three symbols has 62 observed unadjusted closes between 2026-05-06 and 2026-07-31, with no duplicate keys, no invalid or null closes, and no symbol missing from the observed date union. With lookback 5 the expression needs 6 closes per signal, so the 5 warmup exclusions per symbol reconcile exactly to the 57 eligible signals, of which 56 have a next observed close. Because the data-quality source records no defects, the observed evidence supplies no basis for adding a max_absolute_daily_return eligibility exclusion; the research contract requires any added parameter or applicability exclusion to be justified from cited evidence.

citations.quote: All signal calculations use observations at/before t; execution no earlier than the next observed close.
No volume, corporate actions, delisted universe, point-in-time membership, bid/ask, transaction costs, official calendar or forward return labels.

body.statement: Signal timing and execution are fixed by the source contract: every signal uses only closes observed at or before its signal close t, and execution can occur no earlier than the next observed close after t. The last observed date 2026-07-31 has no subsequent observation, which is exactly why only 56 of the 57 eligible signals per symbol carry a next observed close. Because the sources contain no bid/ask, transaction-cost or official calendar data, these next-close counts establish that a next observation exists to read, not tradability or executable trades.

citations.quote: Normalization divides the trailing return by trailing daily-return SD times sqrt(lookback); this does not make an annual Sharpe ratio or remove systematic risk.

body.statement: Cited observation: one-observation return dispersion differs by roughly a factor of two across the sample (300750.XSHE sample SD 0.02520900080828789 vs 600036.XSHG 0.012242446444137979, 601318.XSHG in between at 0.019867351566759856), and the baseline five-observation score SDs follow the same ordering (0.042777151396309596 / 0.027943663754569577 / 0.0402658932201447), so raw score magnitudes are dominated by symbol-specific volatility. Testable hypothesis: an alternative spec retaining lookback 5 and direction 1 but setting normalization to realized_volatility with volatility_window 5 might make score magnitudes more comparable across the three symbols without adding any return-magnitude exclusion; whether it helps in a later evaluation is untested here since no forward labels exist, and the exact coverage and warmup consequences must be confirmed by inspecting the exact spec. Constraints on this hypothesis: the divisor is trailing daily-return SD times sqrt(lookback) and must be positive (zero returns are at most a single observation per symbol, so a five-return window still yields positive SD), and the resulting scaled score is not an annual Sharpe ratio and does not remove systematic risk.

body.statement: All reported statistics are descriptive development-sample summaries, not performance evidence: baseline mean scores have mixed signs across symbols (negative for 300750.XSHE and 601318.XSHG, positive for 600036.XSHG), and no forward labels, PnL or alpha exist, so descriptive score differences - including sign, scale or coverage changes from any revision - cannot establish superiority or a winning direction, and absence of proven alpha does not by itself disqualify exploration. Closes are unadjusted, so close-only jumps such as 601318.XSHG falling from 52.76 on 2026-06-17 to 49.38 on 2026-06-18 cannot be attributed to or cleared of corporate actions. Because the data were retrieved after the research window, they are exploratory development observations, never a holdout.

body.rationale: Retention follows from cited evidence, not inertia. The frozen panel is complete at the observed grain with no recorded defect, so no eligibility bound is justified and none is added. The single motivated alternative, volatility scaling at the same lookback and direction, was inspected on its exact spec: it preserves required closes per signal, warmup exclusions, eligible signals and next-close availability with positive dispersion in every window, yet the hypothesized gain in cross-name comparability is not observed, because score dispersion across the names remains about as wide, its ordering inverts, and the sign pattern of mean scores changes under scaling. With no forward labels, execution returns, costs or corporate-action information, that observed score-scale difference cannot establish improvement, superiority, a winning direction, removed systematic risk or executable trades, so the added parameter is unsupported and the simpler raw spec is retained. The alternative remains a possible arm for a later labeled evaluation, together with vintage price data and defined execution assumptions.
